name: Non-Linear Recurrence Obfuscation
description: Replaces a linear positional encoding (base-N polynomial) with a non-linear recursive sequence evaluated in reverse order. The recurrence is carefully bounded so that it preserves the exact same strict total ordering (lexicographical) without looking like a standard number system. This forces models to algebraically bound the terms to prove the ordering, while defeating naive floating-point simulation due to precision loss.
